_doc: Footswitch positions per pedal catalog id. Written ONLY by scripts/pedal_editor.py. x,y are fractions (0..1) of the Pedal Playground image, origin top-left, in the UNROTATED pedal, at the CENTRE of the switch cap. bypass: true if the switch turns (part of) the pedal on/off, false for tap, preset, toggle and other switches. Optional tap: true for a tap-tempo switch (absent = false). Optional diameter_mm (null if unknown). [] = checked: the pedal has no footswitch. A missing id = unknown. No image is stored.
